phases.title: Content Transfer
phases.summary: All notes, markdown, HTML refs, code files, PDFs, and assignments wired into the app.

phases.title: Component Split
phases.summary: App broken into pages, components, and data files. Routing, search, and glob registry established.

phases.title: Knowledge Base Extraction
phases.summary: ~4,100 entries extracted from HTML references into structured JS — languages, math, CS core, Linux.

phases.title: App Rebuild & UI Overhaul
phases.summary: Dept/course hierarchy, CoursePage tabs, DeptPage layouts, font overhaul, mobile support.

phases.title: PDF Viewer
phases.summary: PDF.js viewer wired. OS textbook live. Remaining course PDFs pending.

phases.title: Search Improvements
phases.summary: Full-text search across notes, code, and talk2me. Knowledge base and PDF search not yet wired.

phases.title: JSX → Data Audit
phases.summary: All multi-consumer and DB-bound constants extracted from JSX into src/data/. roadmap.js, tabs.js, uiConfig.js created.

phases.title: Runtime Content Sync — Detection Only
phases.summary: Manifest generator built. App detects content changes on launch via SyncThing + manifest diff. Currently only notifies — does NOT download or serve new files to the device. Android 16 external storage permissions block full implementation. Actual file delivery requires a self-hosted server (Phase 8b).

phases.title: Self-Hosted Content Server
phases.summary: Host notes, references, and PDFs on a self-hosted server. App fetches new/changed files directly over HTTPS on launch — no APK rebuild needed for content updates. Manifest drives delta downloads. Files cached locally in app storage.

phases.title: Desktop App — V1
phases.summary: Tauri app built and installed on both desktop (kaneki) and laptop (kusuo). App reads and writes directly to src/data/memory.js on disk via custom Rust commands. SyncThing keeps both machines in sync. V1 satisfied — data persists across sessions and machines. Remaining: Talk2Me entries need their own persistence file (talk2me.js) and Rust commands, mirroring the memory.js pattern.
steps: Chose Tauri (Rust, lightweight, ~5MB binary) over Electron (heavier, JS-native, ~150MB) for V1 — Electron remains a viable fallback if Tauri limitations arise
Tauri app built and installed on both desktop (kaneki/MiniKaneki) and laptop (kusuo/MiniSaiki)
Custom Rust commands: load_memory, save_deadlines, list_entries, read_entry, save_entry, delete_entry
File-based persistence: src/data/memory.js written on every change, read from disk on startup via Rust — bypasses bundled snapshot
Project path registered to ~/.coogshub_path by Vite plugin on pnpm dev — portable across machines
Browser (pnpm dev) uses Express /api/save-memory as fallback — same source, two runtimes
SyncThing syncs memory.js between machines — data follows the code via git or sync
Remaining: Talk2Me entries not yet verified in Tauri, other pages not yet persistent

phases.title: Desktop App — Persistence Layer
phases.summary: Complete the file-based persistence architecture. Talk2Me entries currently work in browser via Express but not verified in Tauri. Need talk2me.js as dedicated persistence file, load_talk2me and save_talk2me Rust commands, and first-render guard matching the deadlines pattern. Then verify end-to-end on both machines.
steps: Complete persistence for all pages — Talk2Me entries, skill levels, deadlines all survive close/reopen
Talk2Me: verify list_entries, read_entry, save_entry, delete_entry Rust commands work end-to-end in Tauri
Any other stateful pages follow the same pattern: dedicated .js file + load/save Rust commands + first-render guard
Verify both machines stay in sync after a full session on each

phases.title: Database
phases.summary: Once sync is stable, the manifest becomes the seed. Migrate to a real DB for queryability, user progress, flashcard history, PDF bookmarks, and highlight tracking. Offline-first — DB lives on device, syncs passively.
steps: Choose engine: SQLite via Capacitor (mobile) + better-sqlite3 (desktop)
Schema: entries, courses, files, flashcard_progress, pdf_bookmarks, sync_log
Seed from manifest.json — one-time migration, no data loss
Replace manifest diff logic with DB queries
Track per-file last-read, highlights, bookmarks without rebuilding

phases.title: Frontend Polish
phases.summary: Design system, CSS vars, loading skeletons, flashcard modes, dark/light toggle.

phases.title: Android APK
phases.summary: Capacitor build, self-signed APK, biometric lock, local PDF bundle, sideload to Samsung.
